_comment: Ethane/LTA under the histogram (P0) ABF mean-force estimator: paired replication of the closed kernel temperature sweep, a NEW 350 K point, a matched-sham attribution arm, and two presentation movies. FROZEN 2026-10-03 18:50 UTC before any run (git base 56ab774; docs/LTA_HISTOGRAM_REPLICATION.md). Nothing here is edited after the first production run starts except per_T.350.fr_rate (filled by the safety-only ladder BEFORE the 350 K production, with a timestamp) and the 'execution_log' block.
purpose: (1) Does the LTA uniform-FR benefit survive the move of the presented algorithm to the textbook online histogram estimator (every other closed positive has been replicated: EB, WCA, gateway)? (2) Does the benefit keep shrinking toward neutral at 350 K, as the establishment-starvation reading predicts (ABF window traffic grows with T), or grow, as the entropy-share reading would predict (-TdS share rises with T)? (3) Is the FR gain attributable to the Fisher-Rao DIRECTION, i.e. does FR beat a matched sham that replays its event schedule with random direction (the campaign method rule: one sham per FR arm, the direct arm-vs-sham contrast is the attribution statistic)?
gpu: 3 only (standing rule); one process at a time; all arms of one temperature in ONE process
_temperature_order: execution priority; whatever has not finished when the user wakes is reported as not run

sampler._: identical to configs/uniform_campaign/lta_sweep_prereg.json except abf_estimator; abf_bandwidth is unused by the histogram branch and kept only so the field set is the sweep's; the FR marginal KDE (kde_bandwidth, object B), rate, cadence, start, clip and cap are untouched

reference_rule._: the sweep prereg's rule: kappa = kT/(0.07 rad)^2, steps = round(150000*300/T), burn = round(30000*300/T), split-half dF agreement within 0.2 kT required

rng_pairing: per-T rng_seed = the kernel sweep's, so the histogram ABF arm runs on the SAME initial conditions and Langevin noise stream as the kernel ABF arm of that T (noise-paired across estimators, the EB/gateway replication convention); seed LABELS are fresh (1000-1095; the kernel sweep used 600-615, 700-775, 900-901)
fr_rate_rule: inherited per T from the kernel sweep's safety-only ladders (histogram-replication convention: no FR knob is changed); 350 K (a new T): the same ladder {0.02, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20}, seeds 1110-1111, 120k steps, fr_start 20000, under THIS sampler; largest rate with min ancestor ESS/N >= 0.30 and max lineage share <= 0.05 over the FR-active saves; chosen WITHOUT reading any error metric and written into per_T.350.fr_rate before the 350 K production
sham: fr_sham shadows fr_uniform: at every FR opportunity it performs exactly the number of replacements fr_uniform realised at that opportunity in that seed (event_counts replay), choosing the dying replicas uniformly at random without replacement and the clone sources uniformly among the survivors (wca_abffr_core.uniform_birth_death_torch semantics); no score, no target. Same seeds, same initial conditions, same dynamics noise stream as its partner.

width_rule.why: the engine's existing 180 circular bins (dphi 0.0349 rad = 0.066 A) are the grid the kernel estimator deposits into, and the offline read-out audit found raw-bin read-out ON the accuracy plateau (docs/LTA_READOUT_SWEEP.md); the P0 bias then differs from the kernel bias only by the smoothing matrix
width_rule.clause_a_floor: deterministic P0 floor share <= 0.20 of the histogram ABF's own median e_F(T), floor computed from a periodic cubic interpolant of the reference (no run); evaluated by the analyzer before any FR result is read -- if 180 fails, the analyzer flags it and the ladder's 360 result is the reported width
width_rule.clause_b_plateau: ABF-only ladder n_grid {90, 180, 360}, R = 4, labels 1100-1103, rng_seed 20261003, 300 K, run at the END of the schedule as a sensitivity check: paired |median change| of e_F(T) and I_F from 180 to 360 <= 5 % means 180 is on the plateau; reported either way, not used to re-select

movies._: one seed, R = 1, both arms in one process from the same noise stream; the drawn free energy is the reported estimator's own PMF

replication_rules.fr_effect_within_estimator: paired by seed: Delta = (arm - abf)/abf for I_F and e_F(T); median, bootstrap 95 % CI (10000, seed 20260829), wins
replication_rules.replicates: (i) same sign of median Delta I_F and Delta e_F(T) as the kernel sweep at that T; (ii) if the kernel CI95 upper bound for Delta I_F < 0 then the histogram's is too; (iii) |median Delta I_F(hist) - median Delta I_F(kernel)| <= 10 points OR overlapping CIs; same for Delta e_F(T) with 15 points
replication_rules.absolute_accuracy_acceptable: histogram ABF own median e_F(T) within +25 % of kernel ABF's (legacy read-out, recomputed with the same code), and median I_F within +25 %; better is not a failure
replication_rules.safety: the sweep's genealogy floors: median across seeds of per-seed min ESS/N >= 0.30 and max lineage share <= 0.05 (worst seed reported)

attribution_rule: FR is attributed to its direction at a T if the DIRECT paired contrast fr_uniform vs fr_sham has median Delta I_F < 0 with CI95 upper < 0 (and the sham vs abf contrast is reported alongside)
screening_rule_under_test: the rule proposed for choosing T* from ABF-only data: T_hit/T_run < 0.1 and 0.25 < T_est/T_run < 0.75, with T_hit = median over seeds of the first save at which any replica is in the window and T_est = time at which the median ABF error first comes within 1.5x of its final value; evaluated on the kernel ABF arms (already known before this study: T_hit 1.8-3.0, T_est 36.6-40.8 of 60 at 150-300 K; 80 K non-monotone) and on the histogram ABF arms
endpoints: the sweep's (docs/UNIFORM_FR_CAMPAIGN.md): primary Delta I_F paired median with 10k bootstrap CI, final non-inferiority +5 %, tau atlas convention (persist 0.2 T), genealogy median-across-seeds; e_F = additive-constant aligned full-circle RMS against the umbrella/WHAM reference interpolated to the engine grid; histogram arms are scored by their OWN exact PMF (no kernel re-scoring)

predictions_before_any_run.P1_replication: histogram FR vs histogram ABF at 300 / 150 / 225 / 80 K has the same sign and a magnitude within 10 points of the kernel sweep (-14.8 / -31.9 / -21.3 / -35.1 % integrated; -19.7 / -56.3 / -28.2 / -74.7 % final), 16/16 or 15/16 wins; CIs exclude zero
predictions_before_any_run.P2_baseline: histogram ABF own e_F(T) is within +-10 % of kernel ABF's legacy read-out (0.087 / 0.134 / 0.095 / 0.164 kJ/mol): the read-out audit put raw bins on the plateau, so the online own-bin bias costs little; I_F within +15 %
predictions_before_any_run.P3_350K: benefit keeps shrinking: Delta I_F between -12 % and 0 (ABF crossings per replica > 2.7), final within +-10 %, verdict NEUTRAL or a marginal ACCELERATION_POSITIVE; the reference's entropic share rises above 72 %. If instead Delta I_F < -15 % at 350 K the entropy-share reading gains support and the starvation reading loses -- recorded as the alternative
predictions_before_any_run.P4_sham: the matched sham is NEUTRAL to slightly harmful vs ABF (|Delta I_F| < 5 %, final +0..+10 %) at every T; FR beats its sham directly by at least two thirds of its FR-vs-ABF margin, CI excluding zero (gateway precedent: -11.8 % direct when -12.1 % vs ABF)
predictions_before_any_run.P5_screening_rule: the proposed rule already classifies 150-300 K as establishment-limited on the kernel ABF arms (T_hit/T_run 0.03-0.05, T_est/T_run 0.6-0.7) and the histogram arms will agree; the e0/8 convention (tau 2.4-4.2) does NOT -- i.e. the rule works only with a threshold tied to the FINAL error, not to the initial one
predictions_before_any_run.P6_health: histogram FR fires more replacement events than the kernel FR (+30-70 %, the WCA precedent) and its median min ESS/N stays >= 0.30 at 150-350 K; 80 K may again fall below (0.257 under the kernel)

prohibited: tuning any FR knob or the FR KDE bandwidth
reading any FR metric before per_T.350.fr_rate is frozen (for 350 K) and before the floor clause is evaluated
re-selecting the width after FR results are seen
